description: This file contains functions for processing and transforming HTML templates, including parsing HTML, replacing attributes, handling math rendering with KaTeX, syntax highlighting with PrismJS, and manipulating image elements within the HTML content.

methods.name: buildHTML
methods.description: Asynchronously builds HTML content from a template data object, processing the HTML content with preprocessing steps.

methods.name: preprocessHTML
methods.description: Preprocesses HTML content by replacing tags, handling images, math expressions, and code blocks, then updates the template data.
